Printed by UPPC, Entebbe, by Order of the Government.
Bill No. Financial Institutions (Amendment) Bill 2023
THE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT)
BILL, 2023
MEMORANDUM
The object of this Bill is to amend the Financial Institutions Act, 2004
to repeal section 115B (2) establishing the Central Shari’ah Advisory
Council.
MATIA KASAIJA (MP)
Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development.
i

Bill No. Financial Institutions (Amendment) Bill 2023
ii

Bill No. Financial Institutions (Amendment) Bill 2023
A Bill for an Act
ENTITLED
THE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2023
An Act to amend the Financial Institutions Act, 2004 to repeal
section 115B (2) establishing the Central Shari’ah Advisory
Council.
BE IT ENACTED by Parliament as follows:
Amendment of the Financial Institutions Act, 2004
The Financial Institutions Act, 2004 is amended in section 115B—
(a) by repealing subsection (2); and
(b) in subsection (4) by deleting the words “Notwithstanding
subsection (2)”.
